stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 stash [<subcommand>] [--] [<args>...]

Stash the changes in a dirty working directory away.

Usage:
  git2 stash list
  git2 stash (pop | apply)
  git2 stash [push]

Options:
    <subcommand>
        the subcommand (list, push, pop, apply)
    <args>...
        arguments for the subcommand
